name: AlphaCommerce – Cart Recovery for WooCommerce
author: AlphaCommerce™

sections.description:
AlphaCommerce recovers abandoned carts automatically the moment you activate it. No setup wizards, no cloud accounts, no monthly fees.

How it works:

  1. A customer adds items to their cart and enters their email at checkout.
  2. If they leave without completing the order, AlphaCommerce captures the cart.
  3. A proven 3-step email sequence (30 min, 24 hours, 3 days) is sent automatically.
  4. The customer clicks a link to restore their exact cart and complete checkout.

Key Features:

  • Zero configuration — recovery starts immediately on activation
  • Multi-step recovery — 3-email cadence (30m, 24h, 3d) with smart timing
  • One-click cart restore — customers get their exact cart back
  • GDPR compliant — consent messaging and one-click unsubscribe
  • 30-day dashboard — track captured carts, recovery rate, and revenue recovered
  • Fully local — all data stays in your WordPress database, no external API required
  • Abilities Framework — uses the AlphaCommerce Abilities architecture for secure capability management

External Services

This plugin connects to alphacommerce.io to send a one-time activation ping when the plugin is first activated.

What data is sent and when:
A single non-blocking HTTP POST request is sent to https://alphacommerce.io/api/ping/activate only on the very first plugin activation (never again after that). The request includes:
– Your site URL (home_url())
– The installed plugin version
– Your WordPress version
– Your WooCommerce version
– Your PHP version

No personal data, customer data, cart data, or email addresses are transmitted. This data is used solely for install tracking and compatibility monitoring.

Update checks:
The plugin also periodically checks https://alphacommerce.io/api/plugin/update-check to see if a newer version is available. This request sends only your plugin version and site URL (as part of the User-Agent string). No personal or customer data is transmitted. Results are cached for 12 hours so the request fires at most twice per day. This only applies to copies of the plugin downloaded directly from alphacommerce.io — plugins installed via WordPress.org use the WordPress.org update system instead.

This service is provided by AlphaCommerce:
– Terms of Service: https://alphacommerce.io/terms
– Privacy Policy: https://alphacommerce.io/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu.
  3. Open Cart Recovery in the admin menu — recovery is already active.
sections.faq:
Does it send emails automatically?

Yes. Recovery emails are sent automatically using a high-converting 3-step cadence (30m, 24h, 3d). They use WordPress’s built-in email system and scheduler.

Is this really free?

Yes. The free plugin includes full cart recovery — capture, emails, restore, and reporting. No features are locked behind a paywall.

Why are my emails sent slightly later than scheduled?

WordPress scheduling requires site traffic to process scheduled tasks. For low-traffic sites, set up a server-level cron job (most hosts provide this) or use a service like Cron-job.org to ping your site every 5 minutes.

Does it work with my theme?

AlphaCommerce works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. The cart capture runs on checkout pages using standard WooCommerce hooks.
